propositions: Cumulative error counter streams in observability.sh advance their offset before CloudWatch put-metric-data succeeds, causing transient publish failures to permanently lose the interval's count delta.
A forced AWS call failure leaves the offset advanced to the source total; the next successful run publishes zero instead of the accumulated delta because the baseline has already been consumed.
All seven metric streams across six code shapes (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral/interrupt helper, G2P) share the same construct defect and require coordinated repair.
Offset advancement must move into the successful AWS call branch so that transient failures leave the offset byte-identical for retry by the next interval.

A whole-script PATH-shim regression test must prove that each targeted stream fails publication once without advancing offset, then succeeds and publishes the accumulated delta before advancing offset.
